chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Hammad from Abu Hamrah who said:
I asked him about a man who trimmed his fingernails except for one finger. He said: 'He forgot.' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'There is no harm.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets to trim one fingernail while grooming?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) addresses a specific detail in personal hygiene (*taharat*) regarding the trimming of nails. He clarifies that forgetting to trim a single nail does not constitute a defect in the act, reflecting the Shia juristic principle of *al-istishab* (presumption of continuity) and the ease (*yusr*) in ritual purity matters. This ruling underscores that minor omissions in recommended acts do not invalidate the overall state of cleanliness required for worship.
